description: Check a row: {row:<64-hex id>} → stored verdict (GET /verify?row=, no refetch); {card, job, proof} → fresh check (POST /verify). local:true runs the bundled reference verifier (verify-ref.cjs, same broker) on your machine instead of Peerkith. ok:true only for tier verified. Proof alone → ok:false 'need card+job for full check'.
name: verify
